eir_hold_oenach_decision = {
	picture = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_social.dds"
	}
	ai_check_interval = 0
	sort_order = 40
	desc = eir_hold_oenach_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = eir_hold_oenach_decision_tooltip
	confirm_text = eir_hold_oenach_decision_confirm

	cooldown = { days = 3650 }

	is_shown = {
		eir_is_irish_ruler_trigger = yes
		highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
	}

	is_valid = {
		NOT = { has_character_modifier = eir_oenach_afterglow_modifier }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_available_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
	}

	cost = {
		gold = medium_gold_value
		prestige = 50
	}

	effect = {
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_oenach_afterglow_modifier years = 5 }
		eir_vassal_opinion_effect = { MODIFIER = eir_oenach_opinion OPINION = 10 }
		capital_county ?= { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_oenach_ground_modifier years = 10 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_character_modifier = eir_throne_turmoil_modifier }
			remove_character_modifier = eir_throne_turmoil_modifier
		}
		add_prestige = 100
		set_global_variable = eir_done_oenach
		eir_trait_effect = { TRAIT = gregarious OPPOSITE = shy CHANCE = 10 }
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}
}
